commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Gael Angoula has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+1' Lamine Camara (Metz) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Jean N'Guessan replaces him.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Lamine Camara (Metz) picks up an injury.
90' Gael Angoula couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Remy Cabella (Lille) and blew his whistle.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) replaces Jonathan David.
88' Paulo Fonseca has decided to substitute Edon Zhegrova and he is replaced by Ichem Ferrah (Lille).
87' Remy Cabella (Lille) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
86' Pape Diallo (Metz) is flagged for offside.
84' Remy Cabella (Lille) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
81' Remy Cabella (Lille) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Alexandre Oukidja is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

80' Pape Diallo (Metz) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Lucas Chevalier!
77' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' Pape Diallo (Metz) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
74' Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Simon Elisor.
74' Laszlo Boloni decides to make a substitution. Cheikh Sabaly will be replaced by Pape Diallo (Metz).
72' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) steps up to send the ball in.
70' A substitution has been made. Yusuf Yazici goes off and Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) comes on.
70' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and signals a foul after Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) brought his opponent down.

69' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Lucas Chevalier shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
67' Gael Angoula blows his whistle. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) commits a foul after dangerous play.
63' Ablie Jallow (Metz) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
63' Alexsandro (Lille) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands.
62' Lamine Camara (Metz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Flag goes up against Simon Elisor (Metz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
56' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Andre (Lille) replacing Nabil Bentaleb.

55' Lamine Camara (Metz) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom right corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, though, allowing Lucas Chevalier to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
55' Lamine Camara (Metz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
54' Gael Angoula blows his whistle after Lucas Chevalier (Lille) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Metz.
52' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) will take a goal kick to hopefully start an attacking move for his team.
50' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Metz.
49' Metz enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Laszlo Boloni has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Joel Asoro comes on the pitch for Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' 2 - 0 Jonathan David (Lille) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball in off the right post, giving Alexandre Oukidja no chance.
45+5' Jonathan David (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
45+5' Fali Cande (Metz) commits a rough challenge and Gael Angoula blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee makes the call - penalty to Lille!
45+4' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
45+2' Angel Gomes (Lille) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his long-range effort towards the left post. Brilliant save!
45+2' Lille work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! Yusuf Yazici (Lille) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
45+1' Alexandre Oukidja pulls off a great save to deny Edon Zhegrova (Lille), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Remy Cabella (Lille) is caught offside!
43' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and it's Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
42' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
39' Jonathan David (Lille) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.
38' The resulting corner from Remy Cabella (Lille) is cleared.
37' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly over the crossbar.
36' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
35' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ablie Jallow (Metz).
34' Unbelievable miss! Jonathan David (Lille) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!

33' OFF THE POST! Yusuf Yazici (Lille) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
32' Tiago Santos (Lille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
29' Lucas Chevalier anticipates the direction of the penalty by Simon Elisor (Metz). He attempted to put the ball inside the right post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
29' Simon Elisor (Metz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
28' The Metz players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
28' There's a break in play and referee Gael Angoula must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Metz using VAR. This could be interesting!
27' Leny Yoro (Lille) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Gael Angoula stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a penalty for Metz!
26' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
25' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
24' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
23' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) plays a through ball but overhits it.
22' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner kick, but Alexandre Oukidja reads it well and stops the effort.
22' Remy Cabella (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
18' Remy Cabella (Lille) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
17' Angel Gomes (Lille) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Gael Angoula blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
16' Lamine Camara (Metz) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
13' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
13' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick.
11' Substitution. Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) in, Koffi Kouao out.
10' Remy Cabella (Lille) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' The linesman signals a throw-in for Metz.
8' A pass by Remy Cabella (Lille) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
5' Koffi Kouao (Metz) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
4' Looks like Koffi Kouao (Metz) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
3' Koffi Kouao (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
2' Metz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
Metz will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Gael Angoula.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
